morning.translation: The Throne Verse — a protection and remembrance after Fajr.

morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا أَنْتَ
morning.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord… forgive me, for none forgives sins but You.

morning.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
morning.transliteration: Subhan Allah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illa Allah, Allahu akbar
morning.translation: Glory to Allah; praise; there is no god but Allah; Allah is greatest.

morning.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
morning.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
morning.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.
Sincerity — recite three times for reward of reading the whole Qur'an (per narration on virtue).
Seeking refuge from harm — each three times in some narrations.

evening.translation: Protection before sleep and at evening.

evening.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
evening.transliteration: Subhan Allah, al-hamdu lillah, la ilaha illa Allah, Allahu akbar

evening.arabic: لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
evening.transliteration: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
evening.translation: There is no might nor power except with Allah.
Tawhid before sleep — three times in common practice.
Refuge from evil — three times each in many narrations.
In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live (before sleep).

evening.arabic: رَبَّنَا آتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
evening.translation: Our Lord, give us good in this world and the next, and save us from the Fire.
